description: Poll an SAP Event Mesh queue and trigger Dagster runs per event (job or dynamic-partition mode). REST polling against Event Mesh on BTP, OAuth client_credentials via XSUAA.

queue_name.description: Event Mesh queue to consume from
queue_name.label: Queue Name

oauth_token_resource_key.description: Key of a registered oauth_token_resource (client_credentials via XSUAA)
oauth_token_resource_key.label: OAuth Token Resource Key

peek.description: If true: peek (don't pop) — for read-only observation. If false: consume (pop).
peek.label: Peek (don't pop)

job_name.description: Job to run per message. Mutually exclusive with asset_selection.
job_name.label: Job Name

asset_selection.description: Assets to materialize per message. Use with dynamic_partition_name.
asset_selection.label: Asset Selection

dynamic_partition_name.description: If set: each message registers a new dynamic partition + fires a RunRequest with that partition key.
dynamic_partition_name.label: Dynamic Partition Name

partition_key_template.description: Template for the dynamic partition key. Supports {message_id} + any top-level field of the message body. Default '{message_id}'.
partition_key_template.label: Partition Key Template

tags_template.description: Tags to attach to each RunRequest. Templates resolved like partition_key_template.
tags_template.label: Tags Template

name: SAP Event Mesh Sensor
